name: 81230 · Gunnison, CO
findings: ZIP 81230 (Gunnison) has 50 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 81230 (Gunnison) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 81230 (Gunnison) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 60% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
